findings: The retry plan sets a not-before time but no deadline or attempt schedule enforcing the policy requirement to retry no later than 2026-08-29T20:20:00.000Z.
`maxAttempts: 3` permits only one retry, whereas the policy requires use of two or three attempts. Specify at least two attempts and ensure all attempts occur within the bounded window.
summary: RETRY_LATER and preservation of the unpublished release are supported by the mismatched west confirmation, but the retry plan does not fully encode the required bounded two-or-three-attempt process.
